evals.prompt: Give me a regex to validate a hex color like #fff or #a1b2c3 in JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: Writes must-match and must-not-match cases first (including #ffff, missing #, uppercase, empty), produces an anchored pattern such as /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}){1,2}$/, runs the cases, explains tokens, and gives a JS snippet.
expectations: Lists test cases including near-misses like 4- or 5-digit values
Shows the cases being run with results

evals.prompt: Write a regex to pull all the links out of this HTML page.
evals.expected_output: Recommends an HTML parser (e.g. BeautifulSoup or DOMParser) instead of regex, explains why regex breaks on real HTML, and shows the parser-based code.
expectations: Recommends an HTML parser instead of a regex
Explains why regex is unreliable for HTML

evals.prompt: Our log parser regex `^(\w+\s?)*:` sometimes takes seconds per line. Why?
evals.expected_output: Identifies catastrophic backtracking from the nested quantifier, demonstrates it with a timing test on a long non-matching line, and rewrites the pattern so repetitions can't overlap, then re-tests.
expectations: Identifies the nested quantifier as causing catastrophic backtracking
Provides a rewritten pattern without overlapping repetitions and re-tests it
